what_this_is: Each entry argues that one simulation/ or company/ path, changed between the commit a value-cycle run executed and the publishing HEAD, cannot move the value arms. Read by tools/generate_value_arms_data.py::_code_since_the_run. An entry applies only while run_commit, path and head_blob (git rev-parse HEAD:path) all match.

exemptions.why: The QEP 2.7.1 level-anchor refit, which the 20261004r arms executed uncommitted on top of 96517e68c and which lands in the same commit as those arms. This blob is byte-identical to the file the run imported (git hash-object in /var/tmp/se-qep-arms2), so the run executed this code; it moved only from uncommitted to committed.
